pages.text: When a fraction p of the ends have reacted, chains average $(thing)1/(1 − p)$() units (Carothers): a thousand-unit polyethylene needs p = 0.999. The $(item)Polymeriser$() makes $(item)Polymer Sheet$() from ethylene, $(item)Nylon Fibre$() from propylene, ammonia and nitric acid, and $(item)Aramid Fibre$() from PAH soot spun out of sulfuric acid. Above 420 K it runs away.
